desc: The Gordion semi-automatic shotgun is Retay's lightest model, incorporating the Straight Line Inertia Transfer Action and the Inertia Plus bolt with Rollover Torsion Spring. Built with a durable, single-piece, all-alloy receiver and a Plastic-Free design. features Retay's Easy Out Magazine Unloading system and Dead Straight Deep Bore Barrel ensures optimal shot accuracy. Includes five choke tubes, wrench and shim kit.
